item.title: Cursor capitalizes on Github frustration, launches rival hosting platform
item.description: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, Github.

item.description: Deepfakes are a rising concern, but OpenAI threw fuel onto the fire with its impersonation of the 'Her' actor

item.title: Taco Bell is bringing back 4 discontinued favorite menu items, including one fans begged for
item.description: Now you can return to the carefree days of 2016. Some of the most iconic Taco Bell items have been lost to time, but thanks to one of the fast food chain’s special menus, customers can get a taste of decades past, particularly 2016.

item.title: The US Marines have a new tactic to tackle drones — just shoot them down
item.description: US Marines have begun training on a new drone countermeasures tactic – using traditional small arms to take out UAVs rather than relying on GPS or electromagnetic jamming

item.title: How the ‘mommy track’ derails working women—and it’s only gotten worse
item.description: Corporate America doesn’t care about mothers. This is a problem. In 1988 New York Times journalist Jennifer A. Kingston introduced “mommy track” to the lexicon: Kingston described a then-new phenomenon where prestigious law firms started offering flexible hours and maternity leave to women.

item.title: Disney just sued the Trump administration over an ‘unprecedented’ move against ABC
item.description: The company says the FCC targeted eight ABC stations with early license reviews that violate the network’s First Amendment rights. One of the world’s most powerful brands is standing up to Trump.

item.title: AirPods with cameras arent the only new product that Apple just leaked
item.description: A slew of unreleased Apple products are referenced in the latest macOS beta.

item.title: The internet thought Wattpad was coming for its Harry Styles smut. Here’s what actually happened
item.description: Viral claims of an explicit-content ban sparked fears that years of fan fiction could disappear, but Wattpad says its policies haven’t changed. For some, One Direction is merely a British boy band that sang “What Makes You Beautiful” and introduced the world to Harry Styles. But for fanfic lovers in the mid-2010s, the band and its members were also their lovers, adoptive parents, and sometimes even their kidnappers....

item.title: DOJ’s probe into Andreessen Horowitz over board seats baffles VCs
item.description: Since portfolio companies often pivot and expand into competing markets, investors view occasional conflicts of interest as unavoidable for large VC firms.
